# TheCalculator.us

> TheCalculator.us offers 331 free online calculators for finance, health, math, science, unit conversions, date & time, and everyday life — plus plain-English guides and explainers on the blog. All tools run instantly in the browser; no sign-up required.

Use this file to find the right calculator or article for a task. Each section below lists key pages as Markdown links with a short description. For the full machine-readable index of every page, see the sitemap.

## Popular calculators

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/mortgage-calculator): Estimate monthly mortgage payments, total interest, and amortization for home loans.
- [BMI Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/health/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index with metric or imperial units.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/math/percentage-calculator): Percentages, percent of a number, and percent change.
- [Age Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/datetime/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months, and days between dates.
- [Loan Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/loan-calculator): Monthly payments and total interest for any loan.
- [Tip Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/tip-calculator): Tip amounts, bill totals, and splitting the bill.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/math/scientific-calculator): Advanced math functions in the browser.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Growth of savings and investments over time.

## More key calculators

- [APR Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/apr-calculator): Annual percentage rate for loans and credit cards.
- [ROI Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/roi-calculator): Return on investment, including annualised return.
- [Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/mortgage-payoff-calculator): Extra payments and the fastest way to clear a mortgage.
- [BMR Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/health/bmr-calculator): Basal metabolic rate — calories burned at rest.
- [Calories Burned Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/health/calories-burned-calculator): Calories burned by activity, duration, and weight.
- [GPA Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/math/gpa-calculator): Grade point average from course grades and credits.
- [Ohm's Law Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/science/ohms-law-calculator): Voltage, current, resistance, and power.
- [Time Zone Converter](https://thecalculator.us/datetime/time-zone-converter): Convert times between time zones.
